result:
The newsletter sign-up is in place as a self-contained module, and `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (13 passing), `bunx guren check`, `bunx guren check --arch` and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass. Nothing is committed; the changes are in the working tree.

## Behaviour

- **Subscribe** — `POST /newsletter/subscribe` stores a pending row with a 64-character random hex token and redirects (303) to the `Referer` page, or to `/`.
- **Invalid or duplicate address** — answers 422 with the error under `email` and leaves the table unchanged.
- **Confirm** — `GET /newsletter/confirm/:token` sets `confirmed_at` and redirects to `/`; an unknown token answers 404 and changes nothing.
- **Unsubscribe** — `POST /newsletter/unsubscribe` deletes that row only and redirects like subscribe.
- **Boundary** — I temporarily added an `app/` file importing `modules/newsletter/index.ts` and a `routes/` file importing `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`; `bunx guren check --arch` reported both as failures. Both probe files are removed.

## Things you might not expect

- **Root `db/schema.ts` has a one-line re-export of the module's schema.** `make:module` adds it, and `guren check` has a "schema aggregation" check that looks for it. The table definition itself is only in the module.
- **Addresses are lowercased** before storing and looking up, so `Reader@Example.com` is stored as `reader@example.com`.
- **The `Referer` is only followed when it is same-origin** with the request; anything else redirects to `/`, so the header can't be used as an open redirect.
- **Confirming twice keeps the original `confirmed_at`.**
- **The arch rule also counts type-only imports** as violations.
- **The module's tests import the host app** (`src/app.ts` and `config/database.ts`), so the test file is the one part that needs adjusting when the folder is lifted into another app.

## Summary

I scaffolded `modules/newsletter/` with `guren make:module` and filled it in: `index.ts`, `routes.ts`, `db/schema.ts` (the `newsletter_subscriptions` table), `app/Models/NewsletterSubscription.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/NewsletterValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/NewsletterController.ts`, `tests/controllers/NewsletterController.test.ts` (11 tests) and an ADR under `docs/adr/`. Outside the module, `src/app.ts` registers `newsletterModule`, `db/schema.ts` re-exports the module schema, `db/migrations/20260929173943_create_newsletter_subscriptions/` holds the generated migration, `tsconfig.json` now includes `modules/**/*`, and the regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests carry the three new routes. A new `guren.arch.ts` at the project root forbids anything under `app/` or `routes/` from importing `modules/newsletter/**`.
